note: The tower that stands in the main world (docs/world-tower.md): where it is and its stack of sections, one per floor, bottom first. Read by tools/tower/world/world_tower.py (Blender, makes the models and stack-built.json) and by tools/tower/world/world-tower-build.cs (Unity, makes Assets/Scenes/Tower/WorldTower.unity). To add a floor's section: add it to 'sections' (a style world_tower.py knows, or 'unbuilt' for a plain dark one), run both scripts again. Nothing assumes a number of floors; the cloud cap always sits on the last section.
